description: AspenX deployment preflight catalog. Maps Terraform resource types to required AWS IAM actions, service-linked-role (SLR) requirements, taggability, and cost-safety rules. Update this file whenever new resource types are added to any AspenX stack.
_comment_required_aspenx_tags: null means the key must be present with any non-empty value. A string value means the tag must match exactly that value.
_comment_forbidden_iam_patterns: Patterns checked against the Action field of Allow statements in the bootstrap policy. action_pattern supports exact match or prefix-wildcard (e.g. 'iam:*').

forbidden_iam_patterns.reason: Bare wildcard grants full AWS access. Never permitted in AspenXDeployRole.
Broad IAM grant. Only iam:CreateServiceLinkedRole with iam:AWSServiceName condition is permitted.
Broad STS grant. AspenXDeployRole must not issue tokens or assume arbitrary roles.
Role chaining without Condition enables privilege escalation. Only permitted with a strict ExternalId condition and only in the trust policy, not the permission policy.

_comment_high_cost_resource_types: Resource types whose mere presence in a plan is a cost violation for prototype/Tier-1 stacks.

aws_nat_gateway.reason: NAT Gateway: ~$32/month base + $0.045/GB data transfer. Prohibited in Tier 1 prototype stacks. Use public subnets with publicly_accessible=false on RDS instead.

aws_eks_cluster.reason: EKS control plane: ~$73/month. Not in Tier 1 prototype spec.

aws_opensearch_domain.reason: OpenSearch: expensive data-node cost. Not in Tier 1 prototype spec.

aws_elasticsearch_domain.reason: Elasticsearch (legacy alias for OpenSearch): expensive. Not in Tier 1 prototype spec.

aws_redshift_cluster.reason: Redshift: minimum ~$180/month for smallest node. Not in Tier 1 prototype spec.

aws_elasticache_replication_group.reason: ElastiCache replication group: HA cache cluster cost. Not in Tier 1 prototype spec.

_comment_high_cost_attribute_checks: Per-resource attribute checks for cost violations (e.g. multi_az=true on RDS).

multi_az.reason: multi_az=true doubles RDS instance cost. Forbidden in Tier 1 prototype stacks.

random_id.notes: Terraform-only provider resource. No AWS API calls.

aws_vpc.notes: VPC itself is free. ec2:DescribeAccountAttributes may be needed on first provider init.

aws_subnet.notes: ec2:DescribeAvailabilityZones required to validate AZ names during create.

aws_route_table.notes: Route table and its routes are free.

aws_internet_gateway.notes: IGW itself is free. Data transfer through it incurs standard EC2 data transfer fees.

aws_security_group.notes: ec2:DescribeNetworkInterfaces required to verify SG is unused before delete.

aws_s3_bucket.notes: S3 read actions are required for Terraform refresh even when the resource has not changed.

aws_s3_bucket_policy.notes: Sub-resource of aws_s3_bucket — not independently taggable.

aws_s3_bucket_public_access_block.notes: Sub-resource of aws_s3_bucket — not independently taggable.

aws_s3_bucket_server_side_encryption_con.notes: Sub-resource of aws_s3_bucket — not independently taggable.

aws_s3_bucket_versioning.notes: Sub-resource of aws_s3_bucket — not independently taggable.

aws_cloudfront_origin_access_control.notes: OAC is free. Required before creating a distribution that uses it.

aws_cloudfront_distribution.notes: Distribution propagation takes 5-10 minutes. PriceClass_100 (US/EU/CA) is the lowest-cost option.

aws_db_subnet_group.notes: Subnet group itself is free. Requires subnets in at least two AZs even for single-AZ deployments.

service_linked_roles.trigger: First RDS deployment in an account where AWSServiceRoleForRDS does not yet exist. Subsequent runs skip this call silently.
service_linked_roles.incident_note: Order 624b06c6 failed 2026-05 without this permission. Fixed in cloudformation/tier1-bootstrap.yaml v2.

aws_db_instance.notes: Cost depends on instance_class and multi_az. Prototype stack uses db.t3.micro single-AZ only. AmazonRDSFullAccess managed policy does NOT include iam:CreateServiceLinkedRole — must be added via inline supplemental policy.

aws_cloudwatch_metric_alarm.notes: $0.10/alarm/month. Five alarms in the Tier 1 stack = ~$0.50/month.
